summary: Daughter of Johannes Birkenmayer of Munzingen and wife of Salesius Schuhmacher (1810–1865); possibly an aunt or cousin of the family, and not John's ancestor Maria Anna.
bio: Maria Anna Birkenmayer was born in 1810, a daughter of Johannes Birkenmayer of Munzingen. She married Salesius Schuhmacher, and their son Ferdinand was born at Munzingen in 1828. A contemporary of Servatius Birkenmayer, she may have been his aunt or cousin, but her exact place in the family is not known. She died in 1865 and should not be confused with John's ancestor of the same name, Maria Anna Birkenmayer, who was born in 1837.
